description: Fahrraddepots der Freiburger Verkehrs AG (VAG) in Freiburg i. Br. is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Data Baden-Württemberg. Dieser Geodatensatz enthält die Standorte der Fahrraddepots in Freiburg. Sie gehören der Stadt Freiburg und werden von der Freiburger Verkehrs AG (VAG) betreut. Bei den Fahrraddepots handelt es sich um Fahrrad-Sammelschließanlagen mit je 20 Stellplätzen in Form von Doppelstockparkern, die es ermöglichen Fahrräder trocken und sicher abzustellen. Coverage: Open Data Baden-Württemberg. The portal files it under the publisher Open Data Baden-Württemberg. Its tags are fahrrad, fahrradparkplatz, freiburg-im-breisgau, nahverkehr, opendata. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-09-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
